declaration.preface: Speedrack Products Group Ltd. is committed to upholding internationally recognized human rights and fair Labor practices across our organization and global value chain. As a 100% employee-owned manufacturer of pallet racking and storage systems, we prioritize a work environment that protects the dignity, health, safety, and well-being of all employees, suppliers, contractors, customers, and communities. Respecting human rights is central to our corporate values, culture, and decision-making. This Policy aligns with the UDHR, ILO Core Labor Standards, UNGPs, and applicable local employment laws.
declaration.declaration:
The primary goals of this Fair Labor & Human Rights Policy include:

Establishing clear standards for ethical and responsible Labor practices within Speedrack and across our supply chain.

Preventing and addressing any form of human rights abuse or Labor exploitation, including discrimination, unsafe working conditions, forced Labor, harassment, or unfair treatment.

Promoting diversity, equal opportunity, respect, and workplace inclusion.

Providing guidance to employees, suppliers, and stakeholders on reporting violations and accessing support.

Demonstrating Speedrack’s commitment toward sustainable and responsible manufacturing practices that prioritize people and society.
declaration.scope: This Policy applies to all Speedrack employees, including permanent, temporary, contractual, trainees, interns, management staff and all internal and external stakeholders associated with Speedrack. It covers all company locations and work environments, including manufacturing plants and all offices. Compliance with this Policy is mandatory for all individuals covered under its scope.

Ethical Employment Practices: Ensure fair, transparent, and lawful hiring, onboarding, work conditions, and terminations, protecting workers from exploitation or forced Labor.

Recruitment and employment practices will be strengthened through thorough background checks, transparent contracts, and clear communication of employee rights in accordance with US federal and state labor laws.

The organization will ensure fair and humane working conditions by enforcing standardized working hours, breaks, and weekly off policies in accordance with the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and applicable state laws.
Protection of Vulnerable Groups: Safeguard minors, migrant workers, persons with disabilities, and temporary staff from discrimination or unsafe conditions while promoting diversity and equal opportunity.
We will actively promote diversity and inclusion by implementing employee resource groups, mentoring programs, and awareness campaigns to support underrepresented groups.
Health, Safety & Wellbeing: Maintain safe work environments with proper controls and emergency systems, supporting physical and mental wellbeing.
We commit to fostering a strong safety culture and enhancing employee wellbeing through proactive risk management, safety programs, ergonomics, wellness, and mental health support.
We commit to providing structured, role-based health and safety training to employees every year, with refresher training for high-risk roles.
We are committed to maintaining safe work environments through preventive maintenance and responsible operational controls.

We commit to strengthening employee well-being by continuously promoting mental health awareness and ergonomic best practices through regular communication, training, and workplace improvement initiatives.
We have maintained Zero Lost Time Injuries (LTI) and Zero workplace incidents for the past several years through robust safety systems and strong employee engagement.
Safe and hygienic workplace conditions will be maintained through regular housekeeping, clean sanitation facilities, drinking water access, and proper ventilation in compliance with OSHA standards.
Employee comfort and productivity will be enhanced through ergonomic workstation design, adequate lighting, temperature control, and noise mitigation measures.
Dignified working environments will be ensured by strictly prohibiting overcrowding, unsafe workloads, harassment, or any form of degrading treatment, in line with federal and state labor laws.
Work–life balance will be promoted through flexible work arrangements where feasible, regulated overtime practices, and employee wellness programs, following FLSA overtime regulations.
Fair Compensation & Working Hours: Provide wages, benefits, leave, and hours in line with legal and fair Labor standards; ensure overtime is voluntary and compensated.

The organization will ensure fair and humane working conditions by enforcing standardized working hours, breaks, and weekly off policies in accordance with the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and applicable state laws.
Work–life balance will be promoted through flexible work arrangements where feasible, regulated overtime practices, and employee wellness programs, following FLSA overtime regulations.
Respect & Non-Discrimination: Foster a culture free from harassment or abuse, respecting individual identity and diversity.

We aim to ensure all recruitment and promotion processes are free from bias by implementing structured selection criteria, standardized evaluation procedures, diverse hiring panels, and regular monitoring of decisions for fairness.
We commit to promoting a respectful, safe, and abuse-free workplace, preventing all forms of bullying, intimidation, or harassment, and ensuring dignity and equal respect for all.

The organization will foster an inclusive and respectful workplace by enforcing a zero-tolerance policy against all forms of discrimination and harassment, aligned with Title VII of the Civil Rights Act and applicable state laws.
Recruitment, promotion, and compensation practices will be strengthened to ensure fairness, equal opportunity, and bias-free decision-making through structured processes and objective criteria.
Employee awareness will be enhanced by conducting regular anti-discrimination and anti-harassment training, covering topics such as unconscious bias, workplace conduct, and reporting mechanisms.
Career Management & Development: Support employee growth through training, skill development, mentorship, and clear career progression paths.
The organization will implement structured career development programs by providing clear role progression paths, competency frameworks, and performance-based promotion guidelines.
Employee skill enhancement will be strengthened through targeted training programs, mentoring, and cross-functional exposure to prepare employees for advanced roles.
High-potential employees will be identified and supported through personalized development plans, coaching, and succession planning initiatives.
Transparent performance evaluation processes will be maintained, including regular feedback, goal setting, and career conversations aligned with employee aspirations.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth will be promoted through access to workshops, certifications, and knowledge-sharing platforms across departments.
Human Rights: Uphold fundamental human rights across all operations, ensuring no involvement in violations, forced Labor, or child Labor.
We will implement a zero-tolerance policy for forced & child labor, and human trafficking by embedding strict hiring protocols, employee verification procedures, and supplier compliance requirements.
Employee awareness will be enhanced by conducting regular training sessions on identifying and reporting signs of Labor exploitation.
Supplier and contractor compliance will be ensured by incorporating explicit anti-forced-labor clauses in contracts and conducting periodic audits of high-risk vendors.
The organization will uphold fundamental human rights across all operations by embedding respect for dignity, equality, and non-discrimination into workplace policies and practices.

Employee rights will be protected through clear policies on freedom of association, collective bargaining, privacy, and protection from harassment or retaliation, in line with US labor laws and human rights principles.
Human rights awareness will be promoted through regular training programs, internal communications, and workshops for employees and management.
Expression & Grievance Resolution: Offer confidential channels for concerns and violations without retaliation, encouraging open communication.
We will ensure 100% transparent reporting and closure of all related grievances with documented outcomes and employee feedback tracking.
Conflict resolution mechanisms will be institutionalized by implementing grievance procedures, confidential reporting channels, and mediation processes to ensure fair and timely resolution.
Maintain confidential channels for employees to report workplace concerns or violations.

responsibilities.duty: Endorse and champion the effective implementation of this policy across all business operations.
Ensure adequate resources, systems, and governance mechanisms are in place to protect Labor and human rights.
Review performance reports and drive continuous improvement to uphold global ethical Labor standards.
Integrate human rights considerations into strategic planning, sourcing decisions, and business growth initiatives.
Communicate policy requirements clearly to all employees, contractors, and stakeholders.
Conduct regular awareness programs, training sessions, audits, and compliance assessments.
Track legal, regulatory, and global human rights updates and incorporate revisions into internal practices.
Implement and enforce policy practices within daily operations and team behaviour.
Promote a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace environment free from harassment or discrimination.
Ensure workers are provided equitable treatment, welfare facilities, and rights related to working hours, wages, and breaks.
Understand and comply with the principles outlined in this policy and related procedures.
Participate actively in training, awareness, and improvement programs.
Support a respectful, harassment-free, inclusive work environment.
Maintain honesty, fairness, and professionalism in workplace interactions.

policy.monitoring:
Regular Internal Audits: Conduct periodic audits across operations to verify compliance with labor, health and safety, and human rights standards.

Employee Feedback & Grievance Mechanisms: Maintain confidential channels for employees to report workplace concerns or violations.

Supplier & Contractor Monitoring: Track compliance of suppliers and contractors through contractual obligations, self-assessments, and on-site audits for high-risk vendors.

Performance Metrics & Reporting: Progress will be reviewed quarterly and reported to senior leadership.

Speedrack Products Group Ltd is committed to strengthening its Fair Labor and Human Rights practices in alignment with global ethical standards. The organization will assess performance through audits, employee feedback, and external evaluations, and invest in training, systems, and tools to improve workplace conditions. Speedrack will work with employees, unions, and supply chain partners to identify opportunities and address challenges. Corrective and preventive actions will be taken promptly to resolve non-compliance, close gaps, and protect worker well-being.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), supported by Senior Leadership, will conduct an annual review or as needed of this policy to monitor progress, identify areas for improvement, and ensure alignment with evolving legal, ethical, and industry requirements. Based on review outcomes, compliance assessments, emerging global standards, and organizational needs, the policy may be updated or strengthened accordingly.
